name: Bhey (Lotus Stem Curry)
instructions: 1. Thoroughly clean the lotus stems, slice them into thin rounds, and boil in salted water until tender; drain and set aside.
2. Heat mustard oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, and sauté the onions until golden brown.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute, then add turmeric, chili powder, and coriander powder with a splash of water to prevent burning.
4. Stir in the gram flour and cook until fragrant.
5. Add the boiled lotus stems and toss well to coat them in the masala.
6. Add enough water to create a semi-thick gravy, cover, and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
7. Finish with garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander.
description: Bhey is a classic Himachali dish that showcases the state's love for lotus stem, often harvested from local water bodies. It is a nutritious, earthy dish frequently prepared in households and served with steamed rice or rotis, representing the simple yet flavorful culinary heritage of the region.
